item.title: COMMUNITY | Wrexham AFC Foundation deliver first-ever Street Dragons session in partnership with Llandudno FC
item.description: Wrexham AFC Foundation delivered its first-ever Street Dragons session outside of Wrexham during the February half-term, hosting a successful event in partnership with Llandudno FC. Held at Ty Llywellyn, Llandudno, the session was delivered as part of the Foundation’s funding from the Office of the Police and Crime Commissioner for North Wales. item.description: The Under-18s return to league action this weekend for the first time since their historic FA Youth Cup run came to an end as they were defeated 1-0 by reigning holders, Aston Villa. item.title: FIXTURE NEWS | Swansea City vs Wrexham AFC Women rearranged fixture confirmed
item.description: After the postponement of Wrexham AFC Women’s Genero Premier Fixture against Swansea City last month, fixture details have now been confirmed for the rearranged fixture. The fixture will now take place on Wednesday, March 25 at 7:30pm. In addition to this, the match will be played at Cambrian United's ground, The M&P 3G, CF40 2XX. All tickets will be sold via the home club, with details announced in due course.

item.title: TICKET NEWS | Sheffield United (A) on sale from Monday at 10am
item.description: Tickets for our away fixture against Sheffield United on Saturday March 21, will go on sale to supporters from Monday March 9. We have been allocated 2,850 tickets for the match at Bramall Lane, which kicks off at 3pm. Tickets will go on sale to season-ticket holders at 10am. As per our usual ticket procedure for away fixtures, an allocation of 30% of the tickets will be held back to go on sale to members from 2pm. item.title: CLUB NEWS | Supporters encouraged to arrive early for Joey Jones tribute ahead of FA Cup tie
item.description: Supporters of both sides are encouraged to take their seats early ahead of our FA Cup tie against Chelsea FC, with a tribute to Club icon Joey Jones set to take place before kick-off. item.title: U18 REPORT | Preston North End 1-1 Wrexham AFC
item.description: Julian Widecki-Estima's goal in additional time secured Wrexham AFC Under-18s a 1-1 draw away to league leaders Preston North End. In a tightly contested affair, it took both sides until the final minutes to find the back of the net, with the hosts converting first when Ben Robinson nodded in with only 11 minutes remaining, but Widecki-Estima's goal in the 96th minute meant the game ended level. item.title: REPORT | Wrexham AFC 2–4 Chelsea FC (AET)
item.description: Wrexham AFC produced a spirited display in the FA Cup against eight-time champions Chelsea, falling to a heartbreaking 4-2 defeat after extra time.
